description: Indonesian education criteria against an English CV, and the most instructive case in the whole demo: three of the four come back NO_EVIDENCE, and none of them is a claim about the candidate. The CV is written in English but never states an English ability, and it prints no GPA and no Indonesian institution ranking. 'No evidence found in this CV' is exactly what the system is allowed to say. Hand-authored: this is the reply this application requires for this input, not a transcript of a live provider call.
